add_highlight_circle: add a highlight circle at a 3D world position with a specified radius and optional color
add_line_between_positions: add a colored line between two 3D world positions for visualizing paths or connections
show_modal_dialogue_box: show a modal dialog box with custom title, text, buttons, and optional textbox input
update_camera_transform: update the camera transform including position and quaternion rotation for a specified viewport
draw_object_outline: draw an outline around specified 3D objects with configurable priority, color, and line width
